messages:
alex: Heads-up — vendor (NordEast Logistics) just reported 24 H100s flagged at FRA customs due to a pallet weight mismatch. Landed ETA was 2024-07-08 09:00 CET but now on hold. AWB 219-NE-7741. :grimacing:

maria: Ugh. Are these the pool units for eu-west-1 burst?

alex: Yes, allocation pool-bridge-2. We were planning to top up dedicated for q3. If cleared late we'll miss the provisioning window.

liam: Any photos of the pallet/labels? customs usually hold for documentation mismatch, sometimes trivial.

alex: Vendor attached carrier note but no pallet pics yet. Vendor says customs wants invoice reclassification & thermal packaging evidence.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: "FRA customs requested HS code clarification and weight certificate. Estimated processing 24-72h. Requesting insurer pre-approval for air-expedite if needed."

sophie: If FRA holds >24h we should trigger contingency plan: crossdock from AMS spare pool or expedite partial air uplift for highest-priority SKUs. What's the breakdown by serial?

alex: 24 units across 6 serial batches. 8 units earmarked for a high-throughput customer facing latency-critical rollout (can’t wait). Remaining 16 are pool buffer.

maria: For the 8 priority units: can we borrow from EU refurb pool or swap commit from dedicated partner? cost delta vs air-expedite?

liam: Quick math — air-expedite (same-day air) from FRA to our AMS depot ~ €8k per unit all-in (courier + customs brokerage + surge). Crossdock + truck from next-day AMS spare pool ~ €1.2k/unit but adds 18–24h.

sophie: Given SLOs for that customer, 18–24h misses our target. Recommend authorize air-expedite for the 8. Need finance OK for ~€64k one-off.

maria: Finance, FYI — this is emergent. If we do air-expedite, can we partial-credit vendor on brokerage/insurer if customs error confirmed?

alex: Vendor claims paperwork mismatch on their side. They offered 50% brokerage credit if the issue is their misclass. Asking for proof.

vendor-bot: Vendor uploaded updated commercial invoice and preliminary weight cert (signed). customs response delayed; still under review.

liam: Ops: can you open a temporary RMA split so we can release 8 units for expedite and keep the rest under hold? Need separate AWBs and manifests.

ops-bot: Created RMA-SPLIT ticket #RMA-2024-118. Workflow: split manifest, new AWB for expedite, insurer pre-approve fast-track. Assigned to @maria and @alex.

maria: I'll coordinate with vendor for reclass evidence and push insurance ahead. Alex — can you confirm customer acceptance of expedite cost?

alex: Reached out to customer PM; they approve expedite if we can guarantee <6h in-region setup. PM said yes but asked for cost breakpoint cap €10k/unit — we need to negotiate.

liam: If vendor will cover 50% of brokerage but not uplift, net per-unit cost ~€4k. Still over the PM cap. Suggest we cost-share: company covers €2.5k/unit, vendor €1.5k, customer pays nothing. Finance signoff required.

maria: I'll ping finance and legal. Also request depot photos once units land for TAT logging.

vendor-bot: Vendor confirms willingness to cover brokerage up to 50% and to expedite their paperwork to speed customs.

sophie: Network note — if we redirect 8 units to AMS, schedule config push and cluster tagging beforehand so boots are automated. We don't want manual imaging delay. Ops please pre-stage image + kv-cache warmup profiles.

ops-bot: Pre-staging images onto AMS rapid-provision pool. ETA 3h after AWB handoff.

maria: Finance approved provisional company cost-share up to €25k for this incident, subject to reconciliation if vendor proves fault.

liam: Cool. I'll prepare the manifest split commands. Example snippet for the carrier API:

```
POST /v1/shipments/split
{ "original_awb": "219-NE-7741", "split_counts": [8,16], "destinations": ["AMS_DEPOT","FRA_HOLD"] }
```

maria: Thanks. Alex — once vendor uploads customs clearance ETA I need the new AWB for the expedite package to pre-book courier and insurance.

alex: Got it. Vendor just sent new AWB for the 8: 219-NE-7741-A. Sharing now.

vendor-bot: System note: AWB 219-NE-7741-A created and marked "expedite-requested". Courier assigned: AeroSwift.

sophie: After arrival, label these units with tag: "q3-priority-expedite" and apply canary rollout to dedicated pool to minimize blast radius.

maria: Also filing an ops postmortem task to update vendor contract on HS-code validation checklist and to add required pallet photos pre-shipment.

alex: Thanks everyone. Will update thread when customs clears or if vendor pushes back on cost share. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: Final vendor update at 1744312455: FRA customs cleared 8 units at 13:12 CET after invoice reclass. Units released for pickup. Remaining 16 still pending.
